* Valence electrons in multiple shells
* Can form compounds with negative oxidation number (-1)
* Heavy metal with a density of 19.3 g cm-3
* Can be hammered into thin sheets with a thickness of 230 atoms or less
* Metallic with a yellow color in bulk, but can appear black, ruby, or purple when finely divided
* Most malleable and ductile metal, able to be beaten out to 300 square feet with 1 ounce (28 g)
* Soft metal, often alloyed to increase strength.
